description: Look up an order made with create_domain_order, create_esim_order or create_proxy_order. Statuses: pending_payment (waiting for payment; for a phone-number order held for an ID check, payment_url appears once approved and nothing is charged before that), paid, activating (paid and being prepared, delivered within 10 minutes; if it needs more time the note says so and the buyer is emailed, and they can ask for a full refund before delivery), delivered, failed, refunded. Delivered orders carry the eSIM activation details or the proxy lines. For domains, delivered means registered.

token.description: The access token: the last part of status_url.

name: get_order_status
